trace.question: Which user have only one post history per post and having at least 1000 views?
trace.evidence: having at least 1000 view refers to Views > = 1000; user refers to UserId

attempts.sql:
SELECT UserId
FROM (
    SELECT ph.UserId, ph.PostId, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM postHistory ph
    JOIN users u ON u.Id = ph.UserId
    WHERE u.Views >= 1000
    GROUP BY ph.UserId, ph.PostId
) AS per_post
GROUP BY UserId
HAVING MAX(cnt) = 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT UserId
FROM (
    SELECT ph.UserId, ph.PostId, COUNT(*) AS cnt

trace.answer: No users met both conditions, so the query returned no results.
